title: And so, it begins
content:
Document: WM-001                                                 P. Webb
Category: Announcement                                        2016.12.26

                           And so, it begins

Abstract

   Introduction to this humble blog.

Body

   Welcome to theWebb.blog<a href="https://thewebb.blog?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[1]</a>! I am your host, the <em>most fantabulous</em>
   Paul Anthony Webb a/k/a NetOperator Wibby (virtually everywhere else
   on the vast Internet). What can you expect from theWebb.blog?
   Basically anything that comes out of my head and holds my attention
   long enough to be written about.

   I thought about porting the posts from my previous blog<a href="https://dsgn.io/thoughts?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[2]</a>, but I’d
   rather start fresh. After all, after the <em>tumultuous</em> year that was
   2016, I think we could <em>all</em> use a fresh start.

   As a professional front-end web designer and developer, I thought
   about creating a beautiful theme to showcase my dope skills but I
   tend to go overboard and never release things. I’m aiming to change
   that. I was also going to write my own blogging platform after my
   frustration and false start with Ghost<a href="https://ghost.org?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[3]</a> but then I found Hexo<a href="https://hexo.io?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[4]</a>
   (shoutout to the creator of NX framework<a href="https://github.com/solkimicreb?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[5]</a> for the recommendation)!

   Long story short, I intend to stick around with this blog for quote
   some time. Fancy upgrades and whatnot will happen over the next year
   and years after that. Kottke<a href="https://kottke.org?ref=blog.webb.page" target="_blank">[6]</a> has been blogging since 2008. I
   graduated high school in 2006! <em>Crazy</em>.

   I hope you’ll find my little area on the Internet of interest at
   least a few times. 🕸
